rows.grounds: optative verb expressing prescribed ritual action
demonstrative referring to the stated offering
first member of compound with utsādhanaṃ
resulting destruction or eradication of the family

items.question: What consequence follows from offering a hundred thousand oblations of the specified substances?
premises: One should offer a hundred thousand oblations.
The oblations use the previously specified substances.
Such an offering produces uprooting of the family.
items.inference: Therefore, performing a hundred thousand oblations with these substances results in the uprooting of the family.
uncertainties: The precise nuance of utsādhanaṃ as uprooting, eradication, or subjugation is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: One should offer a hundred thousand oblations; that would bring about the uprooting of the family.
